description:
Triggers a synthetic test alert to verify notification channels (email, webhooks, Slack, Discord).

Use this tool when a user wants to test if their alerting setup is working correctly.

message.description:
Purpose: Custom message for test alert verification.

Example values:
Test alert from Monitor Hub AI
Please ignore this alert

monitor_id.description:
Purpose: Optional monitor ID to associate with the test alert.

Accepted values: Integer ID.

name: trigger_test_alert
